general.ayuda: Human Resources may cancel the case before it has been reviewed by the Financial Control Office by selecting a reason from the catalogue and, optionally, adding a note. The rules catalogue determines the stages at which cancellation is allowed and the available reasons. A cancelled case is closed, retains its full history and allows no further action. As no call has been made before review by the Financial Control Office, the recruitment pool is unaffected.
general.confirmar: The case will be cancelled and no further action will be allowed. Do you wish to confirm the cancellation?
general.cargando: Checking whether the case can be cancelled.
general.no_disponible: The cancellation status of this case could not be retrieved.
general.cancelado_fase: Stage at which the case was cancelled
general.enviando: Cancelling; please wait for the response.
general.error_contenido_no_valido: Check the details: select a reason and review the notes.
general.error_acceso_denegado: You do not have permission to cancel this case.
general.error_version_en_conflicto: The case has changed. Refresh the case details before continuing.
general.error_clave_reutilizada: This cancellation has already been recorded with different details.
general.error_fase_no_admitida: The case is no longer at a stage at which it can be cancelled.
general.error_tras_fiscalizacion: The case has already been reviewed by the Financial Control Office and cannot be cancelled.
general.error_cancelacion_existente: The case had already been cancelled.
general.error_indeterminado: The outcome could not be confirmed. Try again: the same operation will be used and no duplicate will be created.
general.error_general: The case could not be cancelled. Please try again later.
